description: Search for remote jobs using keywords with optional filtering by country or worldwide availability

benefits.description: Comma-separated benefit slugs to filter by (e.g., '401k,health-insurance,equity')

companies.description: Comma-separated company slugs to filter by (e.g., 'stripe,gitlab')

exclude_worldwide.description: When true and country is set, return ONLY jobs specifically available in that country, excluding worldwide/remote jobs. Requires country to be set.

experience.description: Filter by a single experience/seniority level (entry-level, mid-level, senior, manager, director, or executive)

markets.description: Comma-separated market/category slugs to filter by (e.g., 'saas,fintech,healthcare')

salary_max.description: Maximum salary in the specified currency (default USD)

salary_min.description: Minimum salary in the specified currency (default USD)

salary_required.description: If false, include jobs without salary data in salary-filtered results (default: true — only jobs with salary)

type.description: Filter by a single employment type (full-time, part-time, contractor, temporary, intern, volunteer, or other)

worldwide.description: Show ONLY 100% remote jobs available worldwide (overrides country filter)

name: search_jobs
